dataIdInfo.idAbs: DONNINGTON IS A LOW DENSITY SURBUB LOCATED IN THE SOUTHERN SIDE OF BULAWAYO.IT CONSISTS OF 105 STANDS WHICH CONSISTS OF GOVERNMENT BLOCKS,COMMUNITY STANDS,LOTS AND REMAINDERS.
